environment.description: Linux; frozen CW-11 candidate; actual OMP 18.2.10 worker TUI peer; real 60-second clock, real Git WorkflowRun and persistent host shell

items.evidence: Actual omp/18.2.10 stayed below the first review boundary, dispatched exactly at 60.0 seconds, collected non-model state, kept silence-only hang classification unknown, omitted private raw-log content, and cleaned every child/thread/socket resource.

The actual OMP peer processed all 13 normal wakes; provider request count reached 15 across the periodic review, wakes, and workflow execution. Missing provider metrics remained explicitly unknown rather than a fabricated token count.

A real WorkflowRun emitted a confirmed exact-incarnation exit notification in 0.087 seconds, the next scheduler tick was exited, identity matched the bound worker session, private facts were absent, and cleanup left no residue.
